sources.notes: Verified 2026-08-17 format: You spent <currency> <amount> at <merchant> on your Credit Card <masked-card> on <DD/MM>. Date-only source; year is resolved against receivedDateTime and the event remains provisional until statement reconciliation. A separately observed Apple Pay purchase used the identical template and exposed no wallet marker. Explicit merchant channel rules run first; unresolved RAK_WORLD transactions use the configurable APPLE_PAY_POS user default.
